description: MainActivity.java defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, extending SampleActivityBase. It manages UI components such as a fragment and a log view, handles menu options for toggling logs, and initializes logging mechanisms.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages a fragment, menu options, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds a fragment if none exists.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling log visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with wrappers and filters, and links to a log fragment.
